title: Arrays
summary: Read items by index, use length, add and remove with push and pop, and visit every item in a loop.

concepts.title: Adding and removing: push and pop

conceptCard.title: Arrays and indexes
conceptCard.body: An array is an ordered list. Each item has an index, a number that starts at 0. Write the array name and the index in square brackets to read an item. An index with no item gives undefined.

conceptCard.title: length
conceptCard.body: The length property counts the items of an array. Indexes start at 0, so the last index is length - 1. Reading at index length finds nothing and gives undefined.

conceptCard.title: push and pop
conceptCard.body: push adds an item at the end of an array. pop removes the last item and returns it. Both change the array itself, even when it is declared with const.

conceptCard.title: Looping over an array
conceptCard.body: A for loop can count the indexes from 0 up to length - 1. A for...of loop gives you each item directly, without an index. Both visit every item once.
